context.transcript:
Hi, I'm here to visit Maria Gaines.
Her office is in the newsroom.
I believe I need to check in here at the front desk.
Yes, I'll call up to the newsroom and let Maria know she has a visitor.
I have to warn you, there's a large tour group in the building.
It's very crowded and noisy.
Oh, I've heard that the building is of historical interest to architecture enthusiasts.
If it's okay, I'll take a look around after my appointment.
No problem.
While I'm ringing Maria, please fill out this form so I can create your temporary ID.
Sure thing.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，我来拜访玛丽亚·盖恩斯。
她的办公室在新闻部。
我想我得在这里前台办理登记手续。
是的，我会打电话到新闻部通知玛丽亚有访客。
我得提醒你，大楼里有个大型旅游团。
这里非常拥挤又吵闹。
哦，我听说这座建筑对建筑爱好者具有历史意义。
如果可以的话，我在预约之后逛逛四周。
没问题。
在我给玛丽亚打电话的时候，请填写这份表格，这样我可以为你创建临时身份识别卡。
好的。
